Kill [[Royen Beastkeeper]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Kill [[Royen Beastkeeper]] in [[Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)|Nahpui Quarter]] of [[Kaineng City]].
* *BONUS* Kill [[Royen Beastkeeper]] in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
From [[Senji's Corner]], walk out the southern exit into [[Nahpui Quarter (explorable area)]]. Follow the path as indicated on the map. (Directly under the Q in "Nahpui Quarter" on the map, be careful for an over-aggro of Jade Brotherhood, especially if using heroes and henchmen.) When fighting Royen, you may want to move up on the hill above him to remove his damage bonus due to his elevation, but, his skills are all pet based so the elevation bonus only applies to his auto-attacks.
